# Lionel Fairlie

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v5 c16 P34](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0034), [v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** old Kitty Hector  <sub>[v5 c18 P18](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0018)</sub>

## Appearance

Lionel Fairlie is a handsome, large-framed man possessing broad shoulders, a tall, pale, smooth forehead, and lively blue eyes. He has a long red beard and a thick mane of red hair untouched by grey.

_Sources: [v5 c16 P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028), [v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015), [v5 c32 P2](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0002)_

## Personality

Lionel possesses a boisterous, fiery, and blustering demeanor, often shouting, roaring with laughter, or flying into sudden tempers that pass just as quickly. He is highly intelligent, widely read, and enjoys engaging in vigorous intellectual or religious debates. Openly straightforward and assertive, he holds a strong preference for people—especially women—who show spirit and courage. Despite his loud and fearsome exterior, he lacks malice and can display immense open-handed generosity.

_Sources: [v5 c15 P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 c16 P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028), [v5 c16 P55](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0055), [v5 c16 P79](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0079), [v5 c22 P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 c26 P17](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0017), [v5 c26 P20](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0020), [v5 c26 P21](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0021), [v5 c31 P31](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0031), [v5 c32 P1](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0001), [v5 c35 P7](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0007)_

## History

During his youth, Lionel Fairlie was famous for his reckless driving and wild deeds. He courted Harriet Ainslie for two years, but after a sudden argument, he broke off their relationship and hastily married Dinah Coyle, a meek woman whom he ultimately held in contempt for her lack of spirit. Following an issue where he felt cheated in a cow deal by a member of the church session, Lionel quit attending church altogether for twenty years, insisting his wife restrict her donations while forcing him to remain an unobservant pagan. Ten years after his wife's passing, Grace Ashdown visited his farm to ask for financial support and church attendance on behalf of her father, the minister. Though he initially bellowed at her, Grace's spirited retaliation won his admiration, leading him to agree to attend service once a month and contribute one hundred dollars annually to the minister's stipend. Upon returning to church, Lionel saw Harriet Ainslie for the first time in two decades and fell deeply in love with her once more. He began actively courting her, visiting her regularly, and debating with her. He eventually approached Harriet's sister Clementine to secure her release of a youth vow that blocked Harriet from marrying. When Harriet was finally free to accept him, Lionel was overjoyed at the prospect of their upcoming marriage.

_Sources: [v5 c15 P29](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0029), [v5 c15 P30](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0030), [v5 c15 P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 c16 P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027), [v5 c16 P39](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0039), [v5 c16 P54](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0054), [v5 c16 P55](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0055), [v5 c16 P79](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0079), [v5 c17 P0](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0000), [v5 c17 P1](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0001), [v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015), [v5 c22 P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 c26 P17](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0017), [v5 c26 P19](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0019), [v5 c31 P31](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0031), [v5 c32 P1](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0001), [v5 c32 P12](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0012), [v5 c32 P14](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0014), [v5 c35 P7](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0007)_
